title: View of an approval
description: The member view of a submission (protocol 17.9). It is a template over op, and it is not part of the effect. Each value that it shows is a JSON Pointer to a value of op. A schema cannot check that a pointer names a value of op. The PDP checks it and answers invalid_view when it does not.

title.description: The title that the owner reads. It is a text of the service.

fields.description: The fields that the owner reads. Each field is a pair: a label, which is a text of the service, and a JSON Pointer to a value of op.

body.description: A JSON Pointer to a text of op. The owner reads this text in full, as the command.

body_label.description: The label of the body. It is a text of the service.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer [RFC 6901]. The empty pointer names the whole of op.
